headline: Council grants Municipal Support Confirmation to West Capital Power battery project
summary: Council granted a Municipal Support Confirmation for the West Capital Power Capacity Project at 1500 Thomas Argue Road (Ward 5, West Carleton-March) for LT2 Window 1 (Capacity).

headline: Council votes against support for 400 MW / 3.2 GWh storage project
summary: Council declined a Municipal Support Resolution for PowerBank's long-duration storage project weeks before the LT2 capacity deadline.

headline: Support letter issued for Elora BESS
summary: The township issued a Municipal Support Resolution (support letter) for the Elora battery project at 6235 Guelph Street; a zoning amendment followed.

headline: Municipal Support Resolution protocol for utility installations adopted
summary: Selwyn adopted a written protocol setting out what proponents must provide when they ask council for a Municipal Support Resolution.
